source.title: Inspirational Quote Poster | Trust The Seeds You Are Planting | Botanical Typography Wall Art | Retro Gardening Decor

analysis.summary: A charming vintage-style botanical illustration of seedlings in terracotta pots next to a floral watering can and seed packets, paired with a motivational quote.
analysis.subject: Seedlings in terracotta pots and a decorative watering can
analysis.setting: A sunny indoor windowsill or potting bench
analysis.style: Retro screen-print illustration, flat color blocks with grainy texture, naive proportions, and bold graphic outlines
analysis.composition: Still life arrangement in the lower two-thirds, text placed in the upper-left negative space, eye-level perspective, framed by a thin white border
analysis.typography: "Trust the seeds you are planting." in a dark green, hand-painted cursive script with a slight tilt.
analysis.audience: Millennial plant parents, hobby gardeners, and people seeking daily inspiration for their home office or sunroom
analysis.hook: The relatable metaphor of gardening as a slow, rewarding process of personal growth, packaged in a nostalgic mid-century aesthetic.

outputs.title: Potting Bench Progress
outputs.brief: A still-life scene of a weathered potting bench featuring a pair of canvas gardening gloves, a small hand trowel, and a single ceramic pot holding a leafy monstera sapling. The composition occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, leaving the upper-right corner open for text. Use the original palette of forest green, dusty rose, terracotta, and cream with a heavy grain texture to mimic mid-century screen printing. Hand-painted cursive text in dark green reads, 'Give yourself time to bloom.'

outputs.title: The Morning Greenhouse View
outputs.brief: A top-down bird’s-eye view of a garden work table covered in scattered seed packets, a half-peeled orange, and several small sprouting herbs in mismatched ceramic mugs. The palette shifts to include sage green, lavender, ochre, and slate blue with thick linocut-style outlines and overlapping color layers. Frame the scene tightly, focusing on the tactile textures of the wooden table and glossy ceramic glazes. Lettering is centered at the bottom in a bold, blocky serif typeface: 'Patience is the secret ingredient.'

outputs.title: Roots of Resilience
outputs.brief: A minimalist folk-art illustration showing a large, stylized oak tree with an intricate, visible root system stretching deep into a cross-section of the earth. Inside the roots and trunk, paint small geometric patterns in metallic gold to represent hidden progress. The palette features emerald green, navy blue, and coral against a flat off-white background. The rendering is clean and graphic with sharp edges and no grain, focusing on a symmetrical, vertically-centered composition without any text.
